title: Stable probabilities and a logit gradient
promptMarkdown: For logits(1002,1000,1001) and true class3 (one-based), calculate softmax probabilities and cross-entropy using a stable formula. Derive the gradient with respect to all three logits and show its components sum to zero. Explain the significance of this sum and why exponentiating the original numbers directly is a bad numerical method.
hintLadder: Use the largest logit as a common shift.
Check the direction in which every logit changes equally.
